g.text: PR #2389 · Show subagent handback warnings and separate task runs
Task summaries hid handback warnings and merged resumed runs.
User reports and warnings now stay visible; task/run keys preserve separate lifecycles.
BEFORE
AFTER
render_task_notification
summary is always shown to the user.
Handback model notes replace the intended report.
TaskReport::from_notification
handback_report.text replaces model notes.
Warning above report; withheld reports stay hidden.
active_tasks: HashMap<TaskId, TaskEntry>
A resumed run reuses the same task id.
Late completion can overwrite the resumed task.
TaskKey { task_id, run_id }
Progress and completion target one run.
Tool results retain the originating run identity.
TasksPanel
Tasks render in a flat start-time list.
Parent/child relationships are invisible.
ordered_tasks
Choose the known parent run at child start.
Orphans remain visible; cycles cannot loop forever.
Scope: parent ids do not identify runs; nesting uses known start times. Missing parent records stay at the root.
